title: Fettuccine Alfredo Sauce
description: Fettuccine Alfredo is a luxurious Italian pasta dish known for its velvety sauce made from butter, heavy cream, and freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano. Perfectly coating tender fettuccine, this restaurant-quality classic delivers rich, creamy flavor with exceptional simplicity, relying on premium ingredients and careful technique for its signature silky texture.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
items: 1/2 cup (1 stick / 113 g) unsalted butter, cubed, cold
1 1/2 cups (150 g) freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese
1/4 tsp freshly grated nutmeg (optional, for depth)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste

instruction.title: Step 1 – Cook the Pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook fettuccine until al dente (firm to the bite). Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Alfredo Sauce
steps: In a large skillet over medium heat, add the cold butter and cream. Slowly whisk until butter melts and the mixture begins to thicken slightly.
Reduce heat to low to prevent breaking the sauce. Stir in the nutmeg (if using).

instruction.title: Step 3 – Add Cheese
steps: Gradually add the Parmigiano-Reggiano, whisking constantly to prevent clumping. The sauce should be silky and smooth.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Combine Pasta and Sauce
steps: Add drained fettuccine to the skillet, tossing gently to coat.
Use reserved pasta water, 1–2 tbsp at a time, to loosen the sauce if necessary. The sauce should cling beautifully to the pasta.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Season and Serve
steps: Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Plate immediately, garnish with parsley, and optionally sprinkle extra Parmigiano on top.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately while the sauce is hot and silky.
Pair with garlic bread or a crisp Caesar salad.
Finish with extra Parmigiano-Reggiano and freshly cracked black pepper.

chefTips: Cold butter and cream: Using cold ingredients prevents the fat from separating and creates a luxuriously smooth sauce.
Freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano: Pre-grated cheese often contains anti-caking agents that can make the sauce grainy.
Finishing with pasta water: Adds silkiness and helps the sauce adhere to the pasta perfectly.
Serve immediately: Alfredo sauce thickens as it cools, so timing is crucial.
